obligations.note: Retention.isPurgeDue now skips the legal-hold block when status is WITHDRAWN, so withdrawn NPI can be purged while a hold is in force. RET-1 requires that declined or withdrawn NPI is never purged during a legal hold, and no exception covers this.
PR-1242 names ticket CHG-26821, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-06 before review. Its component mortgage.retention matches the only changed file, Retention.java.
Declan Farrell, a baseline-mortgage change_approver and not the author Priya Raman, approved a code_review of commit 289039e52fffee240f96e957101f91e28412432c.
The change is a single commit and the code_review approval names that same head commit, so the approval covers what would be merged.

records/ci/run.json records a successful baseline-mortgage suite on the head commit, and the JUnit report shows 124 tests, 0 failures, and 0 skipped, including unskipped controls.RetentionControlTest#sampledPurgeRespectsHold. That pass is only sample coverage and does not cure the RET-1 violation in the code.
The only touched path, Retention.java, is component mortgage.retention with security_sensitive false, so a security_review approval is not required.
The diff does not touch controls data, control tests, or CI under controls/protected-paths.json, so a control_owner approval is not required.
The ticket type is standard and change.emergency is false, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The withdrawn-case legal-hold carve-out is a deviation from RET-1, and the register has no approved, unexpired exception scoped to RET-1 and mortgage.retention. The listed exceptions are for other obligations, expired, or withdrawn.
Acceptance-ledger entries cover other files and symbols, not Retention.java, and this change does not alter those covered paths, so prior evidence has not lapsed.

summary: The change alters mortgage retention so a legal hold no longer blocks purge of withdrawn cases. That directly violates RET-1, and the exception register does not authorize the deviation. Ticketing, independent approval of the final commit, CI on that commit, and the inapplicable security, control-owner, and emergency gates are in order, but a passing sample retention test does not show that holds are always respected. The change is rejected.
